headline: Taiwan High Speed Rail's big shareholders with 1,000 sheets lock up 85%! Foreign investors reduce holdings, who is taking over? New trains trigger 25% capacity, full analysis
summary: Taiwan High Speed Rail traded around NT$26.15 intraday. Foreign investors have reduced their holdings, while large shareholders with 1,000-share lots hold 85% of the stock.
why: Taiwan High Speed Rail is a listed rail operator on the Taiwan Stock Exchange, and its ownership and capacity plans affect its shares.
